title: Tiny Refinements Elicit Resilience: Toward Efficient Prefix-Model Against LLM Red-Teaming

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using a fine-tuned RoBERTa hate speech classifier to predict the toxicity reward/probability of target LLM responses elicited by red-teaming prompts, and evaluated on the WIKI_TOXIC dataset using RealToxicityPrompts.
Evaluated using the DeepEval framework's referenceless LLM-based bias evaluator on QA pairs generated from 500 randomly sampled questions from the HarmfulQA dataset.
